text:
support-engineering: FYI customer reporting a spike of 504s and timeouts this morning, says it started ~08:20 UTC. They're on hosted inference, steady traffic but p99 jumps to ~3s then 504s.
sam: Can you paste the example request id or a couple timestamps? Need to correlate logs.
customer-advocate: Customer provided request ids: r-2026-03-17-08:21:03 and r-2026-03-17-08:21:18. Also says responses sometimes succeed after 10-20s.
prod-monitor: alert: hosted-gateway.p95_latency >= 1500ms for 08:18-08:25 UTC, queue_depth spikes to 1024 (limit configured 1024) at 08:21:03.
lina: queue_depth at limit — looks like request queue saturated and continuous-batcher backlog grew. I'm seeing large KV cache churn in the same window.
support-engineering: Customer's error body: `{ "error": "gateway timeout", "status": 504 }` and gateway logs show `deadline exceeded` while waiting for dequeue.
maria: Can we repro in staging with a tenant-localized load? Might be related to longseqs + batching window. I'll spin up a ramp test.
sam: Quick checks I ran: `kubectl logs gateway-abc -c gateway | grep r-2026-03-17-08:21` shows repeated `enqueue: accepted` then a backlog log `batcher: backlog_size=768 waiting=12s`.
ops-bot: deployment-notify: canary autoscaler scaled dedicated-pool by +2 at 08:20:54 due to CPU.
lina: Hypothesis: continuous batching + many long sequences caused the batcher to hold batches waiting for keyframe alignment, backlog hit queue_depth cap, gateway started rejecting with 5xx / timeouts.
support-engineering: Repro plan: simulate 200 qps of mixed short/long requests targeting hosted pool with same model version; set client-side seq_len distribution to 2% > 8k tokens.
maria: Repro in staging started — initial results: queue depth rises steadily, p95 jumps, then dequeue stalls. Snapshot logs: ```
[08:21:02] batcher: accept id=r-0001 size=512 seq=8200
[08:21:03] batcher: backlog=790 kv_churn=true wait_ms=11800
[08:21:04] gateway: enqueue=1 queue_depth=1016
[08:21:05] batcher: dequeue failed: deadline exceeded
```
sam: Temporary mitigation for hosted: reduce continuous-batch max_wait_ms from 50ms -> 10ms for affected pool, and set queue_depth soft_limit to 900 with graceful shed. This should cause earlier flushes and avoid long tail.
lina: We should also add a per-tenant longseq rate limiter for hosted to prevent head-of-line blocking.
support-engineering: I notified customer and applied temporary config change to the pool at 08:39 UTC. Asking them to retry.
customer-advocate: Customer retried — they reported fewer 504s but some elevated latencies remain. Will monitor.
maria: Follow-ups: 1) run controlled replay to quantify how much longseqs contribute; 2) add a dashboard for batcher backlog and kv_churn; 3) propose safe default: max_wait_ms=15ms for hosted public pools.
sam: Filed a backlog ticket for automated tenant isolation + longseq throttles. Tagging eng-runtime and eng-sre for follow-up. :eyes: :thumbsup:
support-engineering: Closing thread unless customer re-escalates. Copy of commands used for repro: `wrk -t12 -c200 -d120s --script longseq.lua http://staging-hosted/api/v1/generate` — script injects 2% long requests (8k tokens).
prod-monitor: note: I'll keep retention window on that alert open for 24h.
